ALLOWED_DURABILITY_CLAIM: Native successful return acknowledges file data fsync-before-link for new publication and immutable normal-exit visibility; not arbitrary power-loss durability
CORRECT_CONFLICT_RULE: Reject symlink or byte conflict in both initial-existing and concurrent-link-conflict branches
DURABILITY_REQUIREMENT_SOURCE: Canonical A14 save/terminate/fresh-restore is normal publication/visibility qualification; no crash/fault-recovery case is admitted by this package
READER_SOURCE_ELIGIBILITY: Exact save return observed, corresponding final target present/hash/native ID verified, handoff persisted, writer exit independently confirmed; temporary/static evidence/HEAD are excluded

RULES.CONCURRENT_LINK_CONFLICT: FileExistsError branch compares existing bytes; does not repeat symlink test from initial exists branch. No stronger race/no-alias guarantee asserted than implementation.
RULES.DURABILITY_LIMIT: File fsync before link; no containing-directory fsync, no HEAD/manifest commit, no general power-loss durability guarantee. Successful return is normal publication/visibility contract, not atomic multi-file transaction.
RULES.EXISTING_CONFLICTING_TARGET: Reject immutable output conflict; no overwrite
RULES.EXISTING_IDENTICAL_TARGET: Initial exists branch requires nonsymlink and exact bytes, returns existing path without new fsync
RULES.INTERRUPTION: Before link no final target publication guaranteed; temporary/orphan staging may exist. After link final file may remain even if later hook/cleanup prevents return. No rollback-all claim.
RULES.NATIVE_OPERATION: _write_immutable: temporary file in target directory -> write/flush/fsync/close -> os.link atomic create-if-absent -> unlink temporary
RULES.PARTIAL_WRITE: Temporary file is not final publication; final hard link is attempted only after flush/fsync/close. No syscall/failure injection run here.
RULES.RETRY: Identical bytes reuse same content address; conflicting bytes rejected
RULES.SUCCESS: Final content-addressed target matches full raw bytes; no overwritten prior evidence

TEMPORARY: Native tempfile .planner-* in target directory; runtime-generated filename not guessed/persisted as handoff
